cases.prompt: An intermittent crash has a stable reproducer. Find its root cause.
The new hook fails on malformed JSON. Reproduce and fix it.
A regression test fails after the latest change; isolate why.
Audit this source code for exploitable authentication bypass.
Check this API implementation for injection vulnerabilities.
Review this patch for secrets exposure and unsafe deserialization.
Build a polished responsive landing page for a bookstore.
Design a coherent dashboard layout with accessible colors.
Implement a visually distinctive pricing page.
Explore this CSV and summarize missing values and distribution shifts.
Analyze the attached survey dataset and explain the observed trends.
Compute descriptive statistics and charts from this sales table.
Provide a repo improvement plan, including hook and CI design.
Summarize three workflow repositories and propose a design.

negative_policy: For each skill, cases owned by another skill (or null) are negative cases. Preserve the expected owner rather than treating every non-match as success. Explicit-only workflows are tested by their /command, not automatic routing.
